name: Pulse One
description: A considered addition to your wind-down ritual. A sculpted handle, interchangeable contact head, and a compact form that fits into everyday life.
detail: This original product explores a simple, tactile percussion device. The standard kit includes the illustrated device and round attachment; the travel kit adds a product carrying sleeve.

name: Form Roller
description: A little space to stretch out. A textured foam-roller product designed around a straightforward, repeatable mobility ritual.
detail: A considered surface and open core create a simple piece of everyday movement equipment. Choose the size that suits your space.

name: Range Kit
description: Small tools. Room to move. A coordinated set of three resistance-loop products for a more intentional movement corner.
detail: Three tactile loops, illustrated in complementary finishes. Resistance levels and materials would require physical validation before a commercial release.

name: Restore Wrap
description: A softer landing after a full day. An adjustable wrap product with a simple closure and a clean, unobtrusive silhouette.
detail: The illustrated adjustable straps explore everyday comfort. Temperature performance, fit and safety have not been clinically or physically validated.

name: Point Duo
description: Two simple forms for a more focused pause. Compact mobility-ball products in contrasting sizes and tactile finishes.
detail: An uncomplicated pair designed to sit comfortably in a movement kit. Any therapeutic benefit would need independent evidence.

name: Align Pebble
description: A quiet reminder to check in with yourself. A small wearable product exploring a gentler relationship with desk-time habits.
detail: This is an industrial-product design. Sensing, Bluetooth connectivity and coaching have not been implemented or validated.
